notes.title: NextFest Wrap-up
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45244425/e2a4b6baad1f7da83b038ef30a64beca92e48341.png
What's next?

I'm looking to secure funding to produce this game full time. Know someone? Shoot me a message 
With support I can see this game releasing early 2026. My production to do's include:


2-3 hours of main story content 
Several free-play "challenge" loops 
Level editor with Steam Workshop integration and without jank!
A world populated with hand drawn homunculi and critters
Harmony! Melody! Hire someone that knows music theory
New synths, unique timbres, sound pushed to its limits
Steam Deck support
Localization!!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45244425/fd9bdfe0049c98008cfe090c620affe901b94c0e.png
Don't be a stranger!

It's been exciting to have Stellations out in the wild and know what's working, what's not, and to see enthusiasm for more. The demo will stay up for another couple weeks. If you haven't given the level editor a go, I'd love to see what you make in discord!

I'll leave you with some drawings I added last week.
I look forward to sharing more!
